entity.name: LoanLine

many-to-one.name: accountMove
many-to-one.title: Accounting entry
many-to-one.help: Accounting entry of this installment. A line with a move is considered booked.

boolean.name: isDeferral
boolean.title: Deferral installment
boolean.help: Installment created by a deferral; removed when the deferral is cancelled.

boolean.name: isDraftDeferral
boolean.title: Draft deferral installment
boolean.help: Installment created by a deferral negociated during the setting phase (Draft status); baked into the schedule and never removed by a repayment-phase deferral cancellation.

integer.name: editedFieldSelect
integer.help: Marks which amount was manually edited, to drive the recomputation of the following installments.
